events.title: Powerful Textures: Sprache in Textil — Klingspor Museum
events.description: The Klingspor Museum in Offenbach presents 'Powerful Textures: Sprache in Textil', a unique exhibition exploring the intersection of language and textile art. The show features modern tapestry and textile letter-art, with works by Rudolf Koch and international artists who use fabric, thread, and weaving as their medium for typographic expression. Exquisite calligraphic textiles, embroidered manuscripts, and woven letter compositions demonstrate the ancient tradition of combining text with textile. The exhibition runs from May 9 to August 16, 2026, and is accompanied by workshops where visitors can try their hand at textile lettering. The Klingspor Museum is renowned for its collection of modern book art, typography, and calligraphy from around the world. Open Tuesday through Sunday 11:00-17:00, Wednesday until 19:00.
events.location: Klingspor Museum Offenbach, Herrnstraße 80, 63065 Offenbach am Main

events.title: Hinter dem Spiegel — Marta Hoepffner-Preis für Fotografie
events.description: The Stadtmuseum Hofheim presents 'Hinter dem Spiegel' (Behind the Mirror), the exhibition of award-winning contemporary black-and-white photography from the Marta Hoepffner Prize. This biennial photography competition, organized in cooperation with the Kulturfonds Frankfurt RheinMain, showcases the best in contemporary German photography. The exhibition features works by multiple prize winners, exploring themes of identity, perception, and the nature of photographic representation. Marta Hoepffner (1912-2000) was a pioneering German photographer and teacher whose legacy continues through this prestigious prize. The exhibition runs from July 12 to August 30, 2026, with the Stadtmuseum open Tuesday through Sunday 11:00-17:00. Admission is approximately €5 (reduced €3), making this high-quality photography exhibition accessible to all.
events.location: Stadtmuseum Hofheim, Burgstraße 11, 65719 Hofheim am Taunus

events.title: GIFT — Tödliche Gaben: Natural History Exhibition Museum Wiesbaden
events.description: Museum Wiesbaden presents 'GIFT — Tödliche Gaben' (Poison — Deadly Gifts), a fascinating natural history exhibition exploring the world of poisons. From deadly animals and plants to toxic substances in human history, the exhibition reveals the thin line between healing and harm. Over 500 exhibits include venomous creatures, historical poison cabinets, forensic artifacts, and interactive displays. The exhibition combines natural history with cultural history, showing how poisons have been used in medicine, crime, and mythology. Family-friendly interactive stations let visitors test their knowledge about poisonous plants and animals in Germany. Open Tuesday through Sunday, also Wednesday until 20:00, the exhibition runs until April 4, 2027.

events.title: Lauterbach Schlosspark Open Air — Klassik & Picknick
events.description: The Lauterbach Schlosspark Open Air is a classical music picnic concert set in the beautiful park of Schloss Lauterbach. Regional chamber orchestras and ensembles perform a program of classical favorites, from Mozart to Tchaikovsky, in the park's natural amphitheater. Audiences are invited to bring picnic baskets, blankets, and lawn chairs to enjoy the music in the relaxed park setting. The historic Schloss provides an elegant backdrop, while the lush park grounds create a perfect summer afternoon atmosphere. Wine and sparkling water are available from vendors throughout the park. Tickets are €15-25, with children under 12 admitted free.

events.title: Kassel Kinderfest — Family Day im Park
events.description: The Kassel Kinderfest in the Karlsaue Park is a free family event with activities and entertainment for children of all ages. A giant inflatable playground, climbing wall, and pony rides create a mini amusement park in the park's beautiful green spaces. Educational stations offer science experiments, art workshops, and building challenges, all supervised by trained youth workers. Theater performances, puppet shows, and a children's magician perform on the main stage at regular intervals. Parents can relax at the café tent while children participate in supervised activities. The event is free and runs from 10:00 to 17:00, with food and drink available from concessions.

events.title: Sommerferien-Workshop: Kreatives Gestalten für Kinder
events.description: Im Familienzentrum Mörfelden startet in den Sommerferien 2026 ein spannender Kreativ-Workshop für Kinder zwischen 6 und 13 Jahren. Die jungen Teilnehmer tauchen spielerisch in die Welt des Malens und freien Gestaltens ein und lernen dabei vielfältige künstlerische Techniken kennen. Unter fachkundiger Anleitung können sie ihrer Fantasie freien Lauf lassen und eigene Kunstwerke erschaffen. Alle Materialien werden gestellt, und die Kinder können ihre Werke am Ende mit nach Hause nehmen. Eine Anmeldung ist erforderlich, da die Teilnehmerzahl begrenzt ist. Der Workshop fördert Kreativität, Feinmotorik und Selbstvertrauen in einer entspannten Ferienatmosphäre.

events.title: A Step Ahead — 125 Jahre Mathildenhöhe Darmstadt
events.description: The major anniversary exhibition 'A Step Ahead' celebrates 125 years since the first Darmstadt Artists' Colony exhibition in 1901 at the UNESCO World Heritage Mathildenhöhe. The exhibition connects the historic ideas of the colony with contemporary questions about design, sustainability, and social development. Over 400 exhibits include furniture, architecture models, graphic art, textiles, and decorative arts from the colony's four historic exhibitions between 1901 and 1914. Works by Joseph Maria Olbrich, Peter Behrens, and other colony artists are displayed alongside contemporary commissions that respond to their legacy. The Mathildenhöhe ensemble, with its iconic Hochzeitsturm (Wedding Tower) and exhibition building, provides a breathtaking setting. The exhibition runs from June 6, 2026 to January 31, 2027, with guided tours and special events throughout its duration.

events.title: Powerful Textures: Sprache in Textil — Klingspor Museum
events.description: The Klingspor Museum in Offenbach presents 'Powerful Textures: Sprache in Textil', a unique exhibition exploring the intersection of language and textile art. The show features modern tapestry and textile letter-art, with works by Rudolf Koch and international artists who use fabric, thread, and weaving as their medium for typographic expression. Exquisite calligraphic textiles, embroidered manuscripts, and woven letter compositions demonstrate the ancient tradition of combining text with textile. The exhibition runs from May 9 to August 16, 2026, and is accompanied by workshops where visitors can try their hand at textile lettering. The Klingspor Museum is renowned for its collection of modern book art, typography, and calligraphy from around the world. Open Tuesday through Sunday 11:00-17:00, Wednesday until 19:00.
events.location: Klingspor Museum Offenbach, Herrnstraße 80, 63065 Offenbach am Main

events.title: Bad Hersfelder Festspiele — Open Air Theater
events.description: The Bad Hersfelder Festspiele are among Germany's most prestigious open-air theatre festivals, held in the magnificent Stiftsruine (monastery ruins). The summer season features major productions including classics, dramas, and musicals in the spectacular ruin setting. The 2026 program includes a mix of established favorites and new productions, performed by a talented ensemble of German actors. The atmospheric ruins, illuminated after dark, create a magical backdrop that has made these festival performances famous since 1951. Pre-show dining options are available at restaurants near the venue, and guided tours of the ruins are offered before performances. Tickets range from €20 to €65 depending on seating category and production.

events.title: Brüder Grimm Festspiele: Schneewittchen (Snow White)
events.description: The Brüder Grimm Festspiele in Hanau present 'Schneewittchen' (Snow White), a magical open-air theatre production in the historic Amphitheater at Schloss Philippsruhe. The classic fairy tale is brought to life with stunning costumes, original music, and a talented ensemble cast in the evocative setting of the castle grounds. The production runs 19 performance dates from June 18 through July 29, 2026, with evening shows starting at 20:30. The amphitheater's natural setting creates an enchanting atmosphere as dusk falls during performances. The Brüder Grimm Festspiele are Hanau's signature summer cultural event, celebrating the city's legacy as the birthplace of the Brothers Grimm. Tickets range from €18 to €35, with family packages available; pre-show dining is offered at the Schloss restaurant.

events.title: The World Through AI — Schirn Kunsthalle Frankfurt
events.description: The Schirn Kunsthalle presents 'The World Through AI', a groundbreaking exhibition exploring the impact of artificial intelligence on contemporary art and visual culture. The show features works by international artists who use AI as both a tool and a subject, from AI-generated paintings and sculptures to interactive installations. Visitors can engage with works that learn and evolve in real time, creating a unique experience with each visit. The exhibition critically examines questions of authorship, creativity, and the boundaries between human and machine-made art. A special section offers hands-on demonstrations where visitors can create their own AI-assisted artworks. Running from June 11 to September 20, 2026, the exhibition is accompanied by a comprehensive public program including artist talks and workshops.
events.location: Schirn Kunsthalle, Römerberg, 60311 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Tom Jones — Come Gather Round 2026 Tour Frankfurt
events.description: Legendary Welsh singer Sir Tom Jones brings his 'Come Gather Round' world tour to Frankfurt for an unforgettable evening of music. With a career spanning over six decades, Sir Tom performs his greatest hits including 'It's Not Unusual', 'Delilah', 'Sex Bomb', and songs from his critically acclaimed later albums. His powerful baritone voice remains as commanding as ever, and his charismatic stage presence captivates audiences of all generations. The concert takes place at the Jahrhunderthalle, a premier concert venue with excellent acoustics and comfortable seating. Supporting acts and set times are announced closer to the event date. This is a rare opportunity to see a living music legend in an intimate indoor setting, before he concludes his touring career.

events.title: Rheingauer Weinsommer im Museumshof Eschborn
events.description: The Rheingauer Weinsommer transforms the historic Museumshof in Eschborn into a cozy wine garden experience every Thursday through Saturday evening. Rheingau winemakers present their finest Rieslings, Spätburgunder, and other regional wines for tasting by the glass. Visitors are welcome to bring their own food to enjoy with their wine selections, creating a convivial picnic atmosphere. The Museumshof's historic half-timbered buildings and cobblestone courtyard provide a charming setting for relaxed summer evenings. Live acoustic music on selected evenings adds to the ambiance without overwhelming conversation. Free entry with pay-per-glass pricing makes this an affordable and repeatable summer activity.

events.title: Open Air Poetry Slam — Bad Homburg
events.description: The annual Open Air Poetry Slam in Bad Homburg brings top German spoken-word artists to the beautiful Kurhausgarten for an evening of wordplay and performance. Part of the Bad Homburger Sommer festival, the event features competitive performances where poets have exactly six minutes to present original work. The audience serves as the jury, scoring each performance and determining the winner in an engaging and interactive format. Themes range from personal narratives and social commentary to humorous observations and experimental language play. The Kurhausgarten's lush greenery and evening lighting create a magical atmosphere for this literary celebration. Admission is free, making this accessible poetry event a highlight of the Bad Homburg summer calendar.
events.location: Kurhausgarten/Kurpark, 61348 Bad Homburg vor der Höhe

events.title: Sui Generis — Molinier / Aubrit / Beillard Kunsthalle Gießen
events.description: The Kunsthalle Gießen presents 'Sui Generis', a provocative exhibition featuring the controversial French artist Pierre Molinier alongside a film and installation project by artist duo Aubrit & Beillard. Molinier (1900-1976) was known for his erotic photomontages and fetishistic self-portraits that challenged social and artistic conventions of his time. Aubrit & Beillard's contemporary film installation creates a dialogue with Molinier's transgressive oeuvre, exploring themes of identity, desire, and the body. The exhibition offers a rare opportunity to see Molinier's work in Germany, as his pieces are seldom exhibited outside France. Entry to the Kunsthalle Gießen is free, making this challenging and thought-provoking art accessible to everyone. The exhibition runs until July 5, 2026, with hours Tuesday through Friday 14:00-18:00 and weekends 11:00-18:00.

events.title: Marburger Sommernächte: Sportfreunde Stiller Open Air
events.description: The Marburger Sommernächte (Marburg Summer Nights) open-air concert series kicks off with German indie rock legends Sportfreunde Stiller. Known for their energetic live shows and catchy anthems like 'Ein Kompliment' and '54, 74, 90, 2010', the band performs against the stunning backdrop of Marburg Castle. The Schlossparkbühne provides a natural amphitheater with the illuminated castle creating a magical atmosphere as night falls. The Sommernächte series runs July 16-21 featuring a diverse lineup including Joris, Royal Republic, and Chris de Burgh. Food and drink vendors offer regional specialties and festival favorites throughout the evening. Tickets range from €34.65 to €69.90 and are available from the festival website and authorized ticket partners.

events.title: Nomfusi - Live-Konzert
events.description: Die suedafrikanische Sängerin Nomfusi bringt am 16. Juli 2026 im Alten E-Werk Eschwege die Seele Afrikas auf die Bühne. Mit ihrer Stimme und elektrisierender Bühnenpräsenz präsentiert sie eine Mischung aus Township Music, Soul und Afropop. Ihr Konzertprogramm kehrt zu ihren südafrikanischen Wurzeln zurueck mit groovigen Township-Sounds. Das E-Werk Eschwege ist eine bekannte Veranstaltungshalle in Nordhessen.

events.title: Peter Maffay & Band — Love Places 2026, Fulda Domplatz
events.description: German rock legend Peter Maffay and his band perform at the spectacular Domplatz in Fulda as part of his Love Places 2026 tour. The open-air concert takes place on the cathedral square, with the majestic Fulda Cathedral (Baroque masterpiece) as a breathtaking backdrop. Maffay performs his greatest hits spanning five decades, from 'Über sieben Brücken musst du gehn' to songs from his latest album. This is an additional concert date added due to popular demand following the sold-out original show during the Hessentag. The Domplatz venue accommodates approximately 7,000 spectators, creating an intimate yet grand atmosphere. Tickets are available via Eventim, with standing and seated options available.

events.title: Grillen & Chillen am Weserstein
events.description: Am 17. Juli 2026 laedt der Ankerplatz am Weserstein in Hannoversch Münden zu 'Grillen & Chillen' ein. Die Gäste geniessen Grillspezialitäten von Tim's Catering Service am Zusammenfluss von Werra und Fulda. Der Ankerplatz bietet einen schönen Blick auf das Wasser und die historische Altstadt. Die Veranstaltung ist ideal für einen Sommerabend mit Freunden und Familie.
events.location: Ankerplatz am Weserstein, Tanzwerder, 34346 Hannoversch Münden

events.title: Hann. Münden Altstadtfest — Dreiflüssestadt feiert
events.description: Hannoversch Münden's Altstadtfest celebrates the 'Three Rivers City' where the Fulda and Werra meet to form the Weser. The festival takes place in the beautifully preserved half-timbered old town, one of the largest ensembles of half-timbered buildings in Germany. Live music, street performers, and dance groups entertain visitors across multiple stages and squares. River cruises on the Weser offer a unique perspective on the city and its historic waterfront buildings. Food specialties from the Weserbergland region include river fish dishes, local beers, and traditional baked goods. Free entry and the romantic half-timbered setting make this a highlight of the summer calendar.

events.title: Christopher Street Day Frankfurt — Pride Parade 2026
events.description: Christopher Street Day Frankfurt is one of Germany's largest and most vibrant Pride celebrations, drawing hundreds of thousands of participants from across the region. The highlight is the colorful CSD parade through the city center, featuring elaborate floats, costumed dancers, marching bands, and political activism groups. The parade route starts at the Hauptwache and winds through the city to the Mainufer, where the main stage hosts live music, speeches, and performances. The festival area along the river features food stalls, information booths, and community spaces representing LGBTQ+ organizations from across Hessen. The event runs July 16-19 with a full weekend program including parties, film screenings, and cultural events. All parade and festival area entry is free, with donations supporting LGBTQ+ community projects.
events.location: Hauptwache to Mainufer, 60313 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: 9. Rüsselsheimer WINE-fest
events.description: The 9th Rüsselsheimer WINE-fest brings over 100 wines from the Rheingau, Rheinhessen, and Pfalz wine regions to the beautiful Verna-Park (Stadtpark). Local vintners present their finest Rieslings, Spätburgunders, and Silvaners for tasting and purchase by the glass or bottle. Sommelier-led tasting sessions help visitors discover the nuances of different grape varieties and vintages. Live music from local bands and solo musicians creates a relaxed atmosphere throughout the evenings. Regional cheese and charcuterie boards, Flammkuchen, and other wine-friendly foods are available from food stalls. Entry is free, with a deposit system for wine glasses; the festival runs July 3-5.

events.title: Talentschmiede Konzert — Limburg
events.description: The 'Talentschmiede' (Talent Forge) concert at the Stadthalle Limburg showcases the finest young musicians from the Kreismusikschule and the Hochschule Mainz. Rising classical musicians perform works by Mozart, Beethoven, and contemporary composers, demonstrating the region's musical talent pipeline. The concert is free and open to all, making it an accessible introduction to classical music for new audiences. The Stadthalle Limburg (Josef-Kohlmaier-Halle) provides excellent acoustics for this intimate chamber music presentation. Programs are typically 60 minutes with no intermission, featuring solo and small ensemble performances. Free entry and a relaxed atmosphere make this an ideal evening out for music lovers of all ages.
events.location: Stadthalle Limburg, 65549 Limburg an der Lahn

events.title: Limburger Sommerfest – Open-Air-Konzert im Serenadenhof
events.description: Die Limburger Sommerfeste laden auch 2026 wieder zu stimmungsvollen Open-Air-Konzerten im Serenadenhof zwischen Stadthalle und St. Anna Kirche ein. An diesem Samstagabend präsentiert das zweite Sommerfest Livemusik verschiedener Genres bei freiem Eintritt. Die Konzertreihe hat sich als fester Bestandteil des Limburger Veranstaltungskalenders etabliert und lockt mit einer Mischung aus Rock, Pop und Blasmusik. Biergartenbestuhlung und kulinarische Angebote sorgen für Wohlfühlatmosphäre unter freiem Himmel. Sitzplätze können nicht reserviert werden, daher empfiehlt sich frühzeitiges Erscheinen.
events.location: Serenadenhof, Diezer Straße 13, 65549 Limburg an der Lahn

events.title: Orgelpunkt 2026 - Orgelkonzert
events.description: Im Jubiläumsjahr '500 Jahre Homberger Synode' findet in der Stadtkirche St. Marien der 'Orgelpunkt 2026' statt. An jedem dritten Samstag im Monat um 12:00 Uhr erklingt 30 Minuten Orgelmusik am Ort der historischen Synode von 1526. Die Konzerte bieten Orgelmusik in der historischen Kirche St. Marien. Der Eintritt ist frei, um eine Spende für Kirchenmusik wird gebeten.

events.title: Freiluftkino Frankfurt — Open Air Cinema at the Main
events.description: The Freiluftkino Frankfurt transforms the banks of the Main River into an enchanting outdoor cinema venue for the summer season. Guests watch blockbuster films and classics on a large screen while sitting on deck chairs or blankets under the open sky. The program runs from late June through August and features a curated mix of international hits, German films, and family-friendly favorites. Snacks, popcorn, and cold drinks are available at the venue, and blankets can be rented on site. The atmospheric setting with Frankfurt's illuminated skyline in the background makes this a magical summer evening experience. Tickets are available online and at the box office; early arrival is recommended for best seating.

events.title: Wetzlarer Festspiele — A Scottish Night
events.description: The 73rd Wetzlarer Festspiele presents 'A Scottish Night' at the Freilichtbühne Rosengärtchen, featuring traditional Scottish music and dance. The performance brings together LAGANA, UniCeltics, ClanPipers Frankfurt, a choir, and a string orchestra for an evening of bagpipes, fiddles, and Celtic melodies. The open-air stage in the Rosengärtchen (Rose Garden) provides a stunning natural setting with views over the Lahn Valley. The Wetzlarer Festspiele are the city's premier summer cultural event, running from June 9 through August 1, 2026, under the motto 'Live is Beautiful.' The diverse program includes opera, plays, concerts, and cabaret performances suitable for all tastes. Tickets range from €15 to €47, with discounted rates for students and groups.

events.title: Alte Bekannte — Mehr! Live Open Air Marburg
events.description: Germany's most successful a-cappella vocal ensemble, Alte Bekannte, performs at the Schlossparkbühne in Marburg as part of the Sommernächte series. With over 160 shows since their formation in 2021, the group has become a phenomenon with their unique blend of pop, rock, and classical crossover. Using only their voices — no instruments — they recreate complex arrangements of hits by artists from Queen to Ed Sheeran with astonishing precision. Their live shows are known for their humor, audience interaction, and jaw-dropping vocal virtuosity. The Schlossparkbühne's natural amphitheater setting with Marburg Castle illuminated above provides a magical backdrop. Tickets start at €34.65 and are available through the Marburger Sommernächte website.

events.title: WELCOME____IN BETWEEN — Dirk Pleyer Kunstausstellung
events.description: The Kunstverein Friedberg presents 'WELCOME____IN BETWEEN', an exhibition by artist Dirk Pleyer exploring themes of landscape loss, longing, and the spaces between the familiar and the unknown. Pleyer's works combine painting, drawing, and installation to create immersive environments that question our relationship with the natural world. The exhibition is held at the Wetterau-Museum in Friedberg, a regional history museum that provides a fitting context for Pleyer's landscape-based work. The exhibition runs from May 23 to July 5, 2026, with opening hours Wednesday through Saturday 15:00-18:00 and Sunday 11:00-17:00. Admission is free, and a catalogue with essays accompanies the exhibition. This is a must-see for those interested in contemporary landscape art and environmental themes.

events.title: Peter Maffay & Band — Love Places 2026, Fulda Domplatz
events.description: German rock legend Peter Maffay and his band perform at the spectacular Domplatz in Fulda as part of his Love Places 2026 tour. The open-air concert takes place on the cathedral square, with the majestic Fulda Cathedral (Baroque masterpiece) as a breathtaking backdrop. Maffay performs his greatest hits spanning five decades, from 'Über sieben Brücken musst du gehn' to songs from his latest album. This is an additional concert date added due to popular demand following the sold-out original show during the Hessentag. The Domplatz venue accommodates approximately 7,000 spectators, creating an intimate yet grand atmosphere. Tickets are available via Eventim, with standing and seated options available.

events.title: Bad Homburg Open — WTA 500 Tennis Tournament
events.description: The Bad Homburg Open is a world-class WTA 500 women's grass court tennis tournament, attracting top international players as a key Wimbledon warm-up event. Matches take place on meticulously maintained grass courts in the beautiful Kurpark setting, with the Tennishalle providing a covered center court. The week-long tournament runs June 22-28, culminating in the singles and doubles finals on Sunday, June 28. Spectators can enjoy world-class tennis up close, with practice courts offering opportunities to see players warming up. A public viewing area in the Kurpark screens matches on a large screen, with food and drink concessions creating a festival atmosphere. Day tickets start at €20, with hospitality packages and VIP experiences available for premium viewing.
events.location: TC Bad Homburg, Im Kurpark, 61348 Bad Homburg vor der Höhe

events.title: Izo FitzRoy — Sommerreihe 2026, Trinkkuranlage Bad Nauheim
events.description: British-American singer-songwriter Izo FitzRoy opens the Bad Nauheim Sommerreihe 2026 with her powerful blend of soul, blues, gospel, and jazz. Her rich, commanding voice and heartfelt songwriting have earned comparisons to Aretha Franklin and Mavis Staples. The concert takes place at the historic Trinkkuranlage, an iconic open-air stage in Bad Nauheim's park, surrounded by Art Nouveau architecture. The Sommerreihe is Bad Nauheim's premier summer concert series, attracting top international and German artists to this historic spa town. Audiences are encouraged to bring blankets and arrive early to secure good spots on the lawn. Tickets start at €24 and are available through the Bad Nauheim cultural office and Eventim.

events.title: Orscheler Sommer bewegt! — Sportprogramm
events.description: The 'Orscheler Sommer bewegt!' sports program offers approximately 25 free sports events across Oberursel, encouraging active participation for all ages. Activities include basketball tournaments, beach volleyball, outdoor yoga, skateboarding workshops, and guided bike tours through the Taunus hills. Professional instructors lead each activity, making them suitable for beginners and experienced participants alike. All equipment is provided free of charge — just show up in comfortable sportswear. The program runs from June through August, with events spread across different days and times to maximize accessibility. No registration is required for most activities; simply arrive at the designated meeting point at the scheduled time.

events.title: Apparat (Sascha Ring) — Kulturzelt Kassel
events.description: Sascha Ring, better known as Apparat, brings his genre-defying electronic music to the Kulturzelt Kassel's summer festival series. Known for his work as one-half of Moderat and his acclaimed solo albums like 'LP5' and 'TTV', Apparat blends ambient textures, pulsing beats, and haunting melodies. His live performances are immersive audiovisual experiences featuring synchronized projections and atmospheric lighting. The concert is part of the 39th Kulturzelt Kassel festival, which runs June 19 through July 19, 2026, under the iconic big tent by the Fulda River. The Kulturzelt's intimate setting provides excellent acoustics and a close connection between artist and audience. Food and drink vendors serve regional specialties and festival classics before and during the show.
events.location: Kulturzelt Kassel, Fuldaaue (An der Drahtbrücke), 34131 Kassel

events.title: Annett Louisan — 22 Jahre Bohème, Gutshof Rettershof
events.description: Iconic German chanson singer Annett Louisan celebrates 22 years of her debut album 'Bohème' with a special open-air concert at the historic Gutshof Rettershof in Kelkheim. Known for her delicate, whispery voice and poetic lyrics, Louisan has been a defining figure in German pop chanson since her breakthrough in 2004. Her songs blend elements of chanson, pop, and jazz, creating an intimate and sophisticated musical world. The Gutshof Rettershof, a beautifully restored 16th-century estate, provides a charming courtyard setting for this summer evening concert. Part of the Rheingau Musik Festival and the Kelkheimer Kultursommer, this concert combines exceptional music with historic ambiance. Tickets are available via Frankfurt Ticket, with general admission seating on the courtyard.

events.title: Forty/Forty Saisonabschluss-Party — Centralstation Darmstadt
events.description: Centralstation Darmstadt hosts the 'Forty/Forty — Age is just a number' end-of-season party for those in their late 30s to late 40s. With DJs spinning a mix of 80s, 90s, and 2000s hits, this party provides a relaxed yet festive atmosphere in the unique setting of the historic Centralstation building. The venue, a converted historic power station, offers excellent acoustics and a spacious dance floor. Craft beer, wine, and cocktails are available from the bar throughout the night. The party is a popular end-of-season celebration for Darmstadt's cultural scene. Tickets range from €12 to €15 and are available in advance through the Centralstation website.

events.title: Flohmarkt Dreieich — Großer Trödelmarkt
events.description: The Flohmarkt Dreieich is one of the largest and most famous flea markets in the Rhine-Main region, held on the grounds around the Dreieichhalle. Hundreds of vendors offer an incredible variety of goods: antiques, vintage clothing, vinyl records, books, toys, electronics, and collectibles of every kind. Bargain hunters and collectors from across Hessen make the Saturday pilgrimage to find hidden treasures and one-of-a-kind items. The market sprawls across multiple areas including an indoor hall and outdoor fields, ensuring something for every taste and budget. Food vendors serve hearty German breakfasts, grilled sausages, coffee, and cakes throughout the day. Free entry and easy access by car (A3 exit Dreieich) or S-Bahn (S4 to Dreieich-Buchschlag, then bus OF-50).

events.title: A Step Ahead — 125 Jahre Mathildenhöhe Darmstadt
events.description: The major anniversary exhibition 'A Step Ahead' celebrates 125 years since the first Darmstadt Artists' Colony exhibition in 1901 at the UNESCO World Heritage Mathildenhöhe. The exhibition connects the historic ideas of the colony with contemporary questions about design, sustainability, and social development. Over 400 exhibits include furniture, architecture models, graphic art, textiles, and decorative arts from the colony's four historic exhibitions between 1901 and 1914. Works by Joseph Maria Olbrich, Peter Behrens, and other colony artists are displayed alongside contemporary commissions that respond to their legacy. The Mathildenhöhe ensemble, with its iconic Hochzeitsturm (Wedding Tower) and exhibition building, provides a breathtaking setting. The exhibition runs from June 6, 2026 to January 31, 2027, with guided tours and special events throughout its duration.

events.title: Langen Sommerfest — Stadtpark
events.description: The Langen Sommerfest is the city's annual summer celebration in the Stadtpark, featuring live music, food stalls, and family activities. Local bands and musicians perform on the park stage throughout the day, covering rock, pop, jazz, and folk. Food and drink stalls operated by local vereine offer everything from grilled specialties to homemade cakes. Children's activities include face painting, bouncy castles, and craft stations supervised by youth workers. The festival creates a relaxed community atmosphere where neighbors and families gather to celebrate summer in the park. Entry is free, making it an accessible and enjoyable day out for all ages.

events.title: Rossini-Konzert — KammerChor Hofheim
events.description: The KammerChor Hofheim presents an evening of works by the great Italian composer Gioachino Rossini in a concert that showcases his choral and sacred music. The chamber choir, known for their precision and expressive warmth, performs Rossini's 'Petite Messe Solennelle' alongside other choral works. The concert takes place in one of Hofheim's historic venues, with the program offering a rare opportunity to hear Rossini's lesser-known sacred compositions. The chamber choir format allows for intimate, detailed interpretation of these intricate choral works. Tickets are approximately €15-20, supporting the local Hofheim music scene. This is a must for classical music enthusiasts and those seeking high-quality choral music in the Main-Taunus region.
events.location: Hofheim am Taunus, 65719 Hofheim am Taunus

events.title: Stadtteilfest Zeppelinheim — Neu-Isenburg
events.description: The Stadtteilfest Zeppelinheim is a community festival in the Zeppelinheim district of Neu-Isenburg, celebrating the area's unique Zeppelin aviation history. The festival features live music, food stalls, a flea market, and children's activities including a bouncy castle and face painting. Local vereine and community groups operate the food and drink stands, offering traditional German fare at reasonable prices. The Zeppelin Museum, dedicated to the history of airship travel, offers special opening hours and tours during the festival. The festival provides a wonderful opportunity to experience local community spirit in this historic aviation district. Free entry and free parking available near the festival grounds.

events.title: Wetzlarer Festspiele — A Scottish Night
events.description: The 73rd Wetzlarer Festspiele presents 'A Scottish Night' at the Freilichtbühne Rosengärtchen, featuring traditional Scottish music and dance. The performance brings together LAGANA, UniCeltics, ClanPipers Frankfurt, a choir, and a string orchestra for an evening of bagpipes, fiddles, and Celtic melodies. The open-air stage in the Rosengärtchen (Rose Garden) provides a stunning natural setting with views over the Lahn Valley. The Wetzlarer Festspiele are the city's premier summer cultural event, running from June 9 through August 1, 2026, under the motto 'Live is Beautiful.' The diverse program includes opera, plays, concerts, and cabaret performances suitable for all tastes. Tickets range from €15 to €47, with discounted rates for students and groups.

events.title: Sommerfest Rodgau — Bürgerpark
events.description: The Rodgau Sommerfest in the Bürgerpark is a family-friendly summer celebration featuring live bands, dance performances, and a festive program. Local musicians and cover bands perform on the main stage, with genres ranging from rock to pop to Schlager. Food stalls offer grilled specialties, salads, and refreshing beverages, with plenty of seating areas in the park. Children can enjoy pony rides, a petting zoo, and craft stations supervised by youth organizations. The festival atmosphere is relaxed and community-focused, attracting families from across the Kreis Offenbach region. Free entry and ample free parking make this an easy and affordable summer outing.

events.title: Dietzenbach Culture Summer — Kultursommer
events.description: The Dietzenbach Kultursommer brings live music, theatre, and cultural events to venues across the city throughout the summer. The program features local bands, theatre groups, and artists presenting a diverse range of performances. Evening concerts at the Stadtpark provide a relaxed setting for enjoying music under the open sky. Food and refreshments are available from local providers and community organizations. The Kultursommer runs from June through August with events typically on weekends. Most events are free, making culture accessible to all residents of Dietzenbach and the surrounding area.

events.title: Musical Sommer: 'Der Schimmelreiter' — Weltpremiere Fulda
events.description: The Musical Sommer Fulda presents the world premiere of 'Der Schimmelreiter', a mystery musical adapted from Theodor Storm's classic 19th-century novella. Produced by spotlight musicals, the production features an original score, elaborate sets, and a talented ensemble cast. The story follows Hauke Haien, a driven dike master whose ambition leads him into a dark pact with supernatural forces, embodied by the ghostly white horse of the title. The renovated Schlosstheater Fulda provides a magnificent venue for this ambitious new German musical production. The show runs from June 19 through August 30, 2026, with evening performances Tuesday through Sunday. Tickets start at €49.90, with premium packages including dinner at the adjacent castle restaurant available.

events.title: Bad Vilbel Open Air — Sommerklassiker im Freiluftkino
events.description: The Bad Vilbel Open Air cinema presents classic and contemporary films on a large outdoor screen in the Kurpark. The season runs through the summer with screenings at dusk, providing a magical movie experience under the stars. The program includes a mix of German and international films, family favorites, and art-house cinema. Bring blankets, cushions, and picnic supplies for maximum comfort, or enjoy snacks from the on-site concession stand. The Kurpark setting with its historic spa architecture creates a unique and charming cinema atmosphere. Tickets are available at the box office or online, with regular screenings from June through September.

events.title: Wiesbadener Sommerrodelbahn — Erlebnispark Sommeraktion
events.description: The Wiesbadener Sommerrodelbahn summer action day offers half-price tickets for the city's famous summer toboggan run in the Neroberg park. The 1,200-meter-long track winds through the forest with panoramic views over Wiesbaden, providing thrilling downhill rides for all ages. The special summer action includes additional attractions such as a climbing wall, mini-golf, and a barbecue area. The Neroberg park itself features vineyards, the historic Nerobergbahn funicular, and the Russian Orthodox Church. The combination of adventure sports and the beautiful park setting makes this a perfect family summer day out. Half-price action day tickets €7 per ride or €20 for a day pass.

events.title: Kronberger Sommer 2026 – StadtStrand am Berliner Platz
events.description: Sonne, Sand und Sommerfeeling mitten in Kronberg! Vom 27. Juni bis 2. August verwandelt sich der Berliner Platz in eine urbane Strand-Oase mit dem beliebten StadtStrand, gemütlichen Sommerliegen, einer Boulebahn und einem abwechslungsreichen Programm. Besucher können hier bei erfrischenden Getränken und Snacks entspannen, während Live-Musik und kulturelle Darbietungen für Unterhaltung sorgen. Der Eintritt ist frei, und die Strandatmosphäre lädt zum Verweilen und Genießen ein. Präsentiert vom Stadtmarketing Kronberg in Zusammenarbeit mit lokalen Partnern, ist dies der perfekte Ort für einen sommerlichen Tag mit Familie und Freunden.

events.title: St. Bardo-Treff
events.description: Am 1. Juli 2026 laedt die katholische Pfarrgruppe Karben zum St. Bardo-Treff ins Gemeindehaus in Petterweil ein. Ab 14:30 Uhr sind alle zu einem gemuetlichen Nachmittag mit Kaffee und Kuchen willkommen. Der St. Bardo-Treff ist ein regelmässiges Angebot der Kirchengemeinde zur Begegnung und zum Austausch. Die Veranstaltung ist kostenfrei und steht allen offen.
events.location: Kath. Gemeindehaus St. Bardo, Vilbeler Str. 14, 61184 Karben-Petterweil

events.title: Kronberg Kultursommer — Opel-Zoo Familienfest
events.description: The Kronberg Kultursommer features a special Familienfest (Family Festival) at the Opel-Zoo, combining wildlife education with summer fun. Special animal feeding demonstrations, keeper talks, and behind-the-scenes tours give visitors unique insights into the zoo's work. Children can enjoy face painting, treasure hunts, craft stations, and pony rides in the zoo's spacious park grounds. Live music performances add to the festive atmosphere, with local bands playing family-friendly music throughout the day. The Opel-Zoo is home to over 1,500 animals across 45 hectares and is one of Hessen's most popular family destinations. Regular zoo admission applies (€11-16), with special activity stations included in the ticket price.
events.location: Opel-Zoo Kronberg, Am Opel-Zoo 2, 61476 Kronberg im Taunus

events.title: Frankfurt Comic & Cosplay Convention — Messe Frankfurt
events.description: The Frankfurt Comic & Cosplay Convention at Messe Frankfurt brings together comic fans, cosplayers, and pop culture enthusiasts for a weekend of celebration. Artist Alley features over 100 comic artists, illustrators, and printmakers selling original artwork, prints, and commissions. The cosplay competition showcases incredible handmade costumes with categories for craftsmanship, performance, and group entries. Panels and workshops cover comic drawing techniques, storytelling, cosplay prop-making, and the business of independent publishing. The vendor hall offers comics, manga, figurines, apparel, and collectibles from major publishers and independent creators alike. Day passes range from €15-25, with weekend passes available for dedicated fans.
events.location: Messe Frankfurt, Ludwig-Erhard-Anlage 1, 60327 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Königstein Sommerkonzert — Burg Open Air
events.description: The Königstein Sommerkonzert takes place in the courtyard of the majestic Burg Königstein, one of the largest castle ruins in Germany. The concert features classical and popular works performed by regional orchestras and ensembles, with the castle walls providing spectacular natural acoustics. Audiences are seated in the historic courtyard, surrounded by medieval stone walls and overlooking the Taunus landscape. The program typically includes a mix of overtures, arias, and popular classics, appealing to both classical connoisseurs and newcomers. Pre-concert guided tours of the castle are offered, explaining the fortress's 500-year history. Tickets are available through the Königstein tourist office, with the castle café open before the concert and during intermission.

events.title: Elmgreen & Dragset: Stillleben mit Gemüse — Städel Museum
events.description: The Städel Museum presents a major solo exhibition by the celebrated Scandinavian artist duo Elmgreen & Dragset, titled 'Stillleben mit Gemüse' (Still Life with Vegetables). Known for their provocative and humorous installations that challenge museum conventions and social norms, the artists transform the Städel's exhibition spaces. The exhibition features a series of new site-specific works created for the Städel, alongside selected earlier pieces that explore themes of absence, desire, and display. Visitors encounter unexpected juxtapositions: classical sculpture meets contemporary objects, museum galleries become domestic interiors. The show runs from May 20, 2026 to January 2027, offering plenty of time to experience this landmark exhibition. A richly illustrated catalogue accompanies the exhibition, with insights from the artists and curators.
events.location: Städel Museum, Schaumainkai 63, 60596 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Usingen Altstadtflohmarkt
events.description: The Usingen Altstadtflohmarkt (Old Town Flea Market) transforms the historic half-timbered old town into a massive treasure hunt every first Sunday of the month. Over 100 private vendors set up stalls throughout the picturesque streets of Usingen's medieval center, selling antiques, vintage items, books, records, and household goods. The charming setting of half-timbered houses and cobblestone streets makes browsing a pleasure in itself. The market attracts visitors from across the Taunus region looking for unique finds and second-hand bargains. Coffee and cake stalls operated by local vereine provide refreshments throughout the morning. Free entry and free parking available at the Rathaus parking lot.

events.title: Brüder Grimm Festspiele: Schneewittchen (Snow White)
events.description: The Brüder Grimm Festspiele in Hanau present 'Schneewittchen' (Snow White), a magical open-air theatre production in the historic Amphitheater at Schloss Philippsruhe. The classic fairy tale is brought to life with stunning costumes, original music, and a talented ensemble cast in the evocative setting of the castle grounds. The production runs 19 performance dates from June 18 through July 29, 2026, with evening shows starting at 20:30. The amphitheater's natural setting creates an enchanting atmosphere as dusk falls during performances. The Brüder Grimm Festspiele are Hanau's signature summer cultural event, celebrating the city's legacy as the birthplace of the Brothers Grimm. Tickets range from €18 to €35, with family packages available; pre-show dining is offered at the Schloss restaurant.

events.title: Gregor Meyle & Sophia - Doppelkonzert
events.description: Im Rahmen des Schlosshof Open Air Butzbach treten Gregor Meyle und SOPHIA gemeinsam am 28. Juni 2026 im historischen Schlosshof von Butzbach auf. Die beiden deutschen Pop-Künstler verbinden ihre Musikstile für einen unvergesslichen Sommerabend. Die einzigartige Atmosphäre des Schlosshofs mit historischer Kulisse bildet den perfekten Rahmen. Das Doppelkonzert wird von HIT RADIO FFH präsentiert.

events.title: GrimmsMärchenReich — Hanau Mitmachmuseum
events.description: The GrimmsMärchenReich (Grimms' Fairy Tale Kingdom) in Hanau is an interactive hands-on museum where children and families can step into the world of the Brothers Grimm. Through play, exploration, and creative activities, visitors experience classic fairy tales like Hansel and Gretel, Little Red Riding Hood, and The Frog King. Each exhibit is designed to be touched, manipulated, and explored — from climbing through giant storybook pages to dressing up as fairy tale characters. The museum is located in the historic Congress Park Hanau, adjacent to the Amphitheater at Schloss Philippsruhe. Entry is €2-10 depending on age, and free for children under 3, with special family packages available. The museum is open Tuesday through Sunday 10:00-17:00, offering a perfect family-friendly activity in Hanau.
events.location: Congress Park Hanau / Schloss Philippsruhe, 63450 Hanau

events.title: Historische Stadtführung durch Grünberg
events.description: Stadtführer Werner Faust nimmt Besucher mit auf eine Reise in die Geschichte der Stadt Grünberg mit ihren Klosteranlagen und Fachwerkhäusern. Der Rundgang durch die historische Altstadt zeigt, wie Grünberg im Mittelalter aussah. Die Führung startet am Marktplatz und dauert etwa 90 Minuten. Grünberg blickt auf eine über 800-jährige Geschichte zurueck.

events.title: Offene Altstadtführung inkl. Rathausbesichtigung
events.description: Jeden Samstag um 11:00 Uhr bietet das Tourist Center Alsfeld eine offene Altstadtführung mit Rathausbesichtigung an. Die Gäste erfahren Wissenswertes und Überraschendes über die Geschichte der Stadt Alsfeld, ihrer prachtvollen Fachwerkhäuser und historischen Plätze. Vom weltbekannten Rathaus über die Walpurgiskirche bis zu den vielen kleinen schmucken Gassen führt der Rundgang. Die Führung dauert etwa 90 Minuten und kostet 7 Euro pro Person. Von Mai bis Oktober gibt es zusätzlich sonntags um 14:00 Uhr eine weitere offene Altstadtführung.

events.title: Schlitz feiert – Stadtfest mit Miss-Slitisa-Wahl
events.description: Unter dem Motto 'Schlitz feiert' knüpft die Burgenstadt an die Tradition der trachtenfestfreien Jahre an und lädt am 11. und 12. Juli 2026 zum großen Stadtfest ein. Auf dem historischen Marktplatz mit seinem Kopfsteinpflaster und dem Fachwerkensemble erwartet die Besucher ein abwechslungsreiches Programm mit Livemusik, Tanz und kulinarischen Genüssen. Ein besonderer Höhepunkt ist die Wahl der ersten Miss Slitisa, die am Samstagabend gekürt wird. Das Fest bietet eine wunderbare Gelegenheit, die gastfreundliche Atmosphäre der Burgenstadt mit ihren fünf Schlössern zu erleben. Der Eintritt zum Stadtfest ist frei.

events.title: Bad Hersfelder Festspiele — Open Air Theater
events.description: The Bad Hersfelder Festspiele are among Germany's most prestigious open-air theatre festivals, held in the magnificent Stiftsruine (monastery ruins). The summer season features major productions including classics, dramas, and musicals in the spectacular ruin setting. The 2026 program includes a mix of established favorites and new productions, performed by a talented ensemble of German actors. The atmospheric ruins, illuminated after dark, create a magical backdrop that has made these festival performances famous since 1951. Pre-show dining options are available at restaurants near the venue, and guided tours of the ruins are offered before performances. Tickets range from €20 to €65 depending on seating category and production.

events.title: Opernplatz Sommerfest — Frankfurt
events.description: The Opernplatz in Frankfurt transforms into a vibrant summer meeting point with outdoor dining, live music, and a festive atmosphere. Upscale restaurants around the square set up outdoor terraces, offering everything from Italian cuisine to sushi to classic Frankfurter specialties. Live jazz, soul, and acoustic performances create a sophisticated ambiance on the square throughout the evening. The Alte Oper, illuminated against the night sky, provides a stunning architectural backdrop. The relaxed, cosmopolitan atmosphere attracts a mix of professionals, tourists, and locals enjoying the warm summer evenings. Free to attend — simply find a table at one of the restaurants or grab a drink from the pop-up bars.

events.title: Witzenhausen Sommertreiben — Stadtfest
events.description: The Witzenhausen Sommertreiben is the city's annual summer festival celebrating the cherry-growing capital of Hessen. Local fruit growers present their finest cherries and cherry products, from fresh fruit to jams, juices, and cherry liqueur. Live music, dance performances, and a small fun fair create a festive atmosphere in the old town. Food stalls offer regional specialties with a cherry twist, including cherry cake, cherry beer, and cherry-glazed grilled dishes. Guided walks through the surrounding cherry orchards are offered, explaining the region's cherry-growing traditions. Free entry and a welcoming community atmosphere make this a delightful summer destination.

events.title: Monets Küste: Die Entdeckung von Étretat — Städel Museum
events.description: The Städel Museum presents 'Monets Küste: Die Entdeckung von Étretat', a major special exhibition exploring Claude Monet's iconic paintings of the Normandy coastline. The exhibition brings together over 60 paintings and works on paper by Monet alongside works by contemporaries such as Courbet, Boudin, and Turner. It focuses on Monet's repeated visits to Étretat between 1883 and 1886, where he captured the dramatic chalk cliffs and sea arches from multiple perspectives. Interactive multimedia stations allow visitors to compare Monet's different interpretations of the same motif across seasons and times of day. The exhibition runs until July 5, 2026, and is accompanied by guided tours, lectures, and a richly illustrated catalogue. Audio guides are available in German and English, and the museum café offers a themed menu inspired by Normandy cuisine.
events.location: Städel Museum, Schaumainkai 63, 60596 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Hugenottenmarkt 2026
events.description: Der traditionelle Hugenottenmarkt findet vom 3. bis 5. Juli 2026 im Zentrum Friedrichsdorfs statt. Das Strassenfest bietet ein Bühnenprogramm auf zwei Bühnen mit Live-Musik, eine Kunsthandwerksmeile sowie vielfältige Speisen und Getränke. Rund 60 Stände präsentieren ihr Angebot. Der Eintritt zu diesem von HUGO e.V. organisierten Fest ist kostenfrei.
events.location: Innenstadt Friedrichsdorf, Landgrafenplatz bis Rathausplatz, 61381 Friedrichsdorf
